_about: Visual slots: every thing you can SEE in the game names a slot here. The game shows a coloured placeholder shape until a model for the slot exists at assets/models/<slot>.glb (or .tscn). Models are fitted to the slot (size, feet on the ground at the origin, facing -Z) by the asset pipeline, so new art can never change how the game plays. size_m is [width, height, depth] in metres. See _agents/assets.md.

npc_guide.notes: a friendly character who gives missions

portal.notes: walk in to travel to another level

enemy_basic.notes: a basic enemy that chases you
